nodes.description: Preclinical gene replacement has restored auditory responses in homozygous null mice after neonatal cochlear AAV1 delivery, adult intracisternal delivery through the cochlear aqueduct, and AAV8 injection at five weeks with assessment 27 weeks later. The latter does not demonstrate reversal after treatment of already aged animals. These interventions have not established efficacy in dominant A211V disease; augmentation, suppression or combined strategies require variant-specific testing. No human SLC17A8 interventional study was identified in the reviewed research; the registered NCT01802190 study is observational.

nodes.description: VGLUT3 supports glutamate loading into inner hair cell synaptic vesicles. Central-terminal protein reduction in the knock-in cannot be assumed in cochlear cells: the 2021 study found comparable inner hair cell VGLUT3 immunofluorescence and distribution between genotypes. Variant-specific effects therefore remain important.

nodes.description: The founding c.632C>T (p.A211V) variant segregated in two families with evidence of distant shared ancestry and was absent from 267 controls. Later reports include c.616dupA (p.M206Nfs*4) and c.763+1G>T. The 2016 frameshift report sequenced one proband from an affected pedigree; it did not demonstrate segregation across all eight affected relatives. Predicted truncation and splice disruption do not establish a shared dominant mechanism.

The findings differ by study and preparation; they do not establish universally normal ribbon morphology or uniform transport loss in dominant human variants.

nodes.description: Homozygous Slc17a8 null mice model complete loss of vesicular glutamate transmission with profound hearing loss and extra-cochlear effects including seizures. The published vestibular study found strongly reduced quantal transmission but relatively preserved spontaneous vestibular nerve activity and most balance tests, with some assay differences. Nonquantal compensation is proposed; this is not proof of normal human vestibular function.

nodes.description: The allele-matched model, and the reason this entry carries two hypothesis groups. A single point mutation was introduced into exon 5 of mouse Slc17a8, exchanging the codon for the alanine that corresponds to human A211. It reproduces the progressive course the null mouse does not, and it reaches a different conclusion about where the disease starts.
